column3: NKJV names the wise first, following the order of the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “five were foolish and five wise.”
NKJV has “the bridegroom is coming,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “Behold, the bridegroom!”
NKJV includes “in which the Son of Man is coming,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “nor the hour.”
Close to the Greek; NKJV adds “the kingdom of heaven” as the subject.
NKJV joins “immediately” to “went on a journey”; in the critical text “immediately” begins the next sentence.
Close to the Greek; “worthless” is rendered “unprofitable.”
